title: Bolder hand for akshaisrin.live
question: Foreign forms at full commitment. The deal put Nixie Lab Counter in the lead; Acetate Manual beat it on both axes. Pick one, or re-roll again.

options.label: Nixie Lab Counter
options.thesis: The portfolio as a bench instrument whose proof is counted in plasma: real metrics glow in glass tubes on a blackened-steel panel engraved with the name.
options.viewport: A steel instrument front panel. Engraved nameplate: AKSHAI SRINIVASAN, model line CE + AMATH · UNIVERSITY OF WASHINGTON. Below it a legend strip engraves the three running roles: GM Cruise MLE Intern, UW WEIRD Lab RL research, DubHacks Director of Technology. Across the panel, tube banks count up the real proof on load: HACKERS SERVED 1200, STUDENTS 1200, APPLICATIONS REVIEWED 1800, EDGE REQUESTS 376000, each digit a physical depth change. A rotary range selector is the section nav (About, Experience, Projects, Skills, Contact). Two jewel-lamp push buttons are the actions: RESUME and EMAIL. One bank is labeled BOBA and overflows. On phones the banks drop to essential digits.
options.risk: Blackened steel and orange glow is the near-black-with-one-neon-accent look this redesign exists to leave; it survives only if glass, mesh, and engraved steel are physically rendered, never flat glow CSS. A counter is about quantities: the who and the direction need engraved prose that a counter panel does not naturally carry.

raised.raise: No boxes, rules, or dividers anywhere: grouping is done by glow depth and mesh density alone.
One vertical axis rules the page: every experience and project is pinned to its date on a single engraved timeline.

options.label: Acetate Manual
options.lineage: boxed-software reference manuals with tabbed divider boards
options.thesis: Akshai, Reference Manual, Release 2026.08: each section a full-strength colored divider board, every fact printed on a milk-acetate leaf hinged above it, the whole extent drawn as a tab rail down the fore edge.
options.viewport: A manual lying open. The chrome-yellow board fills the viewport edge to edge; a milk-acetate title leaf hinges a millimetre above it: AKSHAI SRINIVASAN, Reference Manual, Release 2026.08, then a Configuration block listing the three roles and CE + AMATH @ UW. RESUME and EMAIL are printed as keystroke legends on the acetate template. Down the right fore edge, a stepped tab rail: About, Experience (oxide orange), Projects (teal), Skills (ultramarine), Contact (violet), each tab's height proportional to its length; the current tab extends and becomes the board. Nothing eases: every hinge is a 90ms two-frame step.
options.case: Recruiters and engineers read a manual instantly and it structures a resume better than any counter; the section boards at full strength carry more color than the whole category dares.
options.risk: Slides into the editorial rut if the boards are not held at full strength; a manual's dry tone means the playful streak must live in errata slips and margin notes, deliberately.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.thesis: The name set proudly in coarse pixels at poster scale; the low resolution is the aesthetic, and the retro-game streak is the headline.
options.viewport: AKSHAI SRINIVASAN built from visible pixels towers over dense justified columns; the same face repeats at five sizes down to smooth gray text carrying the three roles. A bitmap/smooth toggle is an honest state. Resume and email are specimen footnotes in the accent.
options.case: Clearer than the counter at poster scale, but it says games, not robotics, so the primary audience identifies less.
options.risk: Reads as a designer's type poster; pixels must scale only in whole multiples or the whole idea collapses.

options.label: Azulejo Hall
options.thesis: A hall of cobalt-on-white narrative panels: each experience painted as a scene, grout seams running straight through it, a cartouche naming the year.
options.viewport: A panel sixty tiles wide: a cobalt line painting of a robot arm over a hackathon floor, cartouche reading AKSHAI SRINIVASAN · SEATTLE · MMXXVI, the three roles brushed in roman caps along the border frieze. Resume and email as painted plaques. Layout snaps to whole tiles; sections are framed panels walked in order.
options.case: A walkable sequence of framed panels is clearer than banks of digits, but nobody in the audience identifies with a tile hall, and every scene must be authored as line art.
options.risk: Requires real illustration per experience; without it the tiles are empty and the world is wallpaper.

options.label: Struck Cathode Gauze
options.thesis: Every role and project present at once as a dark ghost; the chosen one struck forward in orange.
options.viewport: An unframed plane of ghosted names with one struck forward.
options.case: Materially a twin of the leader with worse scanability: ghost text everywhere is the opposite of what a skimming recruiter needs.
options.kept: No boxes or dividers; grouping by depth.

options.label: Mesophotic Dive
options.lineage: technical deep dives down a volcanic wall
options.thesis: Scrolling is descent: surface, thermocline, reef, wall, ascent home.
options.viewport: A depth gauge tracks the scroll; sections deepen in blue.
options.case: The depth metaphor is generic and cyan on dark blue is the other half of the rut.
options.kept: One vertical axis; every fact pinned to its exact position on it.
options.risk: Pretty scroll effect, no product meaning.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The developer portfolio this category ships, executed impeccably: name, typed roles, social icons, card grid.
canonCard.viewport: Centered name and one-line identity, social row, sections stacked below with a card grid of projects.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other CS student portfolio by design.
